notes.title: Check out Asteros at Steam NextFest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Steam NextFest is here! Don't forget a free demo is out for Asteros!

Good luck out there on Asteros!

notes.title: Asteros demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are excited to announce that the Asteros demo is now available on Steam!  Delve into the heart of Asteros' research facility and perhaps discover a few secrets!  We hope you enjoy it as much as we've enjoyed working on it!

As a reminder, Asteros is also taking part in Steam NextFest starting on February 24.  We would love for you to show your support!

Thank you so much from everyone on the Recursive team!

notes.title: Trailer and Steam NextFest Demo Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

[h3]A new trailer has dropped! Not only that, Asteros will have a playable demo to everyone at Steam NextFest on February 24th! I hope to see you all there![/h3]
